name: azeroth-armory
description: World of Warcraft website: character profiles, PvP & Mythic+ leaderboards, classes and realm status, built on the official Blizzard Battle.net API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
